title: 帆软增长谋士 MCP 配置
description: 填写您的 MOSS MCP API Key。请在帆软 MOSS 管理后台「数据资源-MCP」中由租户管理员生成。凭证仅存储在本机 WorkBuddy 目录，云端不保存。
description_en: Enter your MOSS MCP API Key. Generate it as a tenant administrator in the Fanruan MOSS admin console (Data Resources > MCP). Credentials are stored only in your local WorkBuddy directory and never uploaded.
docLabel: 如何获取 MOSS MCP API Key？
docLabel_en: How to get a MOSS MCP API Key?

fields.label: MOSS API Key
fields.placeholder: 在 MOSS 管理后台「数据资源-MCP」生成
fields.placeholder_en: Generate in MOSS console (Data Resources > MCP)
fields.description: MOSS 租户级 Bearer Token，由租户管理员在管理后台生成。
fields.description_en: MOSS tenant-level Bearer Token generated by the tenant administrator.
